aggregate_arithmetic_and_inventory_check.checked: All split conditional confusion arithmetic and four-class macro F1; Pro group conditional item totals; conservative class/group count conservation, bound ratios, identical primary/global reference denominators and subset counts.

compatible_attribute_acceptance.specific_failure: All four class precisions are below 0.90; general_work and industry_domain recall are below 0.80; macro F1 is below 0.85. All four classes remain represented; general_work is underpredicted (131 predictions against 228 references), so aggregate accuracy does not establish balanced class quality.

decision_reason: Frozen rules require compatible attribute gates and primary confirmed relation precision >=0.90 / recall >=0.80 overall and separately for GA and GB. Attribute gates fail; primary overall 1578/2278 precision and 1578/2501 recall fail, as do both sufficiently supported GA and GB groups. Stop this field implementation; no real-shard sidecar or production inference is authorized under these rules.
frozen_rule_nature: Root-set engineering acceptance rules for this bounded field attempt; not universal literature standards or proof of human truth.
next_action: Preserve completed fit and evidence; report quality/linkage gap. No automatic label/model/parser changes or reruns.

primary_confirmed_relation_acceptance.denominator_policy: Primary predictions are all numeric spans covered by actual frozen experience evidence, including needs_review and unresolved old objects, in accepted year/object contexts. Both inventories retain all original explicit numeric references in those contexts. Missing, ambiguous and unmatched references remain unconfirmed; no reference unknown is converted to a negative.

review_scope: One final acceptance of completed public aggregate report against pre-result execution lock; no private rows or new fitting.
unsupported_claims: Independent human-truth accuracy: retained Pro operational references are not independent human gold.
Blind final validation: final was previously exposed.

Full end-to-end relation precision or complete same-item chain accuracy: only contextual object classification plus frozen numeric binding was evaluated; unconfirmed predictions are not proven false positives.
Advertisement-weighted or whole-corpus quality: metrics use normalized complete contexts without ad weights.
Quality of all original final1331 contexts: recovered context inventory includes 1328, while original holdout membership is retained; no quality claim fills the missing contexts.
